samples_reviewed.question_text: Measure the object. Its length is ___ cm.
Measure the object. Its length is ___ cm.
Measure the object. Its length is ___ cm.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The lc covers measuring AND comparing lengths in m or cm, plus distance in meters, but all 5 samples are the identical single-object cm-measuring stem ('Measure the object. Its length is ___ cm.') -- meters and comparison between two objects never appear.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: length_measurement registers only 2 axes / 4 combos, and the sample set shows only the cm sub-case with varying answers (21,14,9,3,2 cm), leaving the meters case and the comparison case entirely unobserved in this batch.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The 7-word stem 'Measure the object. Its length is ___ cm.' is well inside the 18-word cap and matches the concrete, single-step measurement task appropriate for grade 2 quarter 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: With only 4 registered combos across 2 axes it is plausible meters and comparison items exist elsewhere in the space, but none of my 5 samples demonstrates them, so I cannot confirm the full 'measure and compare ... in meters or centimeters' scope is reached.

competency_alignment.rationale: Single-object cm measurement is a correct subset of this lc but does not by itself demonstrate the comparison skill ('compare lengths of objects') the wording explicitly requires alongside plain measuring.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Observed lengths (2 to 21 cm) are sensible, hand-measurable classroom-object sizes for grade 2, a reasonable progression before distances in meters would be introduced.
